annotations.title: Is this price a good deal

description: Whether a price offered for one product is a good deal: GOOD DEAL, NOT A GOOD DEAL or NOT ENOUGH DATA, by the same written rules as should_i_buy. Compares the price with the lowest current retailer price iDevice read today, the lowest read in the last 90 days and the near-low band the rules use, and gives the buy-or-wait verdict at that price where the rules can state one. Each line says what it rests on. No model is involved and no probability is given.

price_usd.description: The price offered, in US dollars

retailer.description: Where the price was offered, e.g. 'Best Buy'. Repeated in the answer as given.
